newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Oct 14.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Oct 14.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Organisers of oil and gas exhibition in Abu Dhabi expect deals worth $2 billion.
- Gulf Arab states set aside $43 billion to finance future oil projects.
- First stage of expanding Abu Dhabi and al-Ain airports in the United Arab Emirates to cost $317 million.
- United Arab Emirates announces huge projects to develop oil production, refining and petrochemical.
- Jordanian prime minister says negotiations over Qatari liquified gas in Aqaba continues.
- Brisk trading on the Kuwaiti Stock Exchange. More than 393 million shares worth $287 million were traded on Sunday.
